what: Chlorophyll-a in bottle samples, to calibrate the buoy fluorometers
how: Take a surface bottle sample for chlorophyll extraction at every buoy service visit (monthly if possible); compare it with the night-time fluorescence (avoids daytime quenching); clean the optical window.
why: The buoys read 2 to 3 times more chlorophyll than the satellite and the model, so offshore algae levels cannot be checked against any trusted measurement.
reasons: sources disagree; no trusted in-situ sensor; sensor exists but is not trusted; gap in time; an official threshold depends on it
evidence: disagree: yes (chl in situ vs satellite: bias -0.72 to -0.37 log10 mg/m³ (typical error 0.2), R2 of anomalies 0.00 to 0.13 (disagree below 0.3)) | no_trusted_insitu: yes (no sensor with trust good or usable reporting here) | untrusted_sensor: yes (flagged in datahub: EUXRoOB01 chl: indicative, EUXRoOB02 chl: indicative, EUXRoOB03 chl: indicative) | time_gap: yes (no trusted source passes the trend gate here; longest buoy record 1 complete year(s), a trend needs 8 (OURS)) | decision_at_stake: yes (May-Sep mean chl, marine waters south (RO MSFD 2024) (OFFICIAL-RO))
label: Criteria, ranking and thresholds OURS; evidence from the validation and seasonal results of 2026-11-23; all numbers indicative

why: At the coast the model reads about 1.5 mg/L less oxygen than the water samples, and the new coastal buoys are not yet trusted, so coastal oxygen has no reliable check.

where: North-western shelf bottom water, 20-40 m, including the mussel farms Mangalia - 2 Mai (May to September)
what: Bottom dissolved oxygen, about 1 m above the seabed, May to September
how: A bottom oxygen sensor (optode) on a mooring at the mussel farms, or monthly CTD casts with an oxygen sensor at 20, 30 and 40 m depth from May to September.
why: Oxygen near the seabed is where fish and mussels can suffocate, and no sensor measures it near the coast: the dashboard relies on models that disagree with each other.
reasons: sources disagree; no trusted in-situ sensor; gap in time; an official threshold depends on it
